mapper.select: select c.course_id, c.category_id, c.teacher_id, c.course_name, c.course_subtitle, c.cover_image, c.intro, c.last_content_time, c.enroll_count, c.like_count, e.progress_percent, e.enroll_status, e.last_study_time, e.finish_time, u.nick_name as teacher_name from edu_course_enroll e inner join edu_course c on e.course_id = c.course_id left join sys_user u on c.teacher_id = u.user_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.enroll_status = '1' and c.del_flag = '0' order by e.create_time desc
mapper.update: update edu_course_enroll set progress_percent = greatest(ifnull(progress_percent, 0), #{progressPercent}), last_study_time = sysdate(), finish_time = case when greatest(ifnull(progress_percent, 0), #{progressPercent}) >= 100 then ifnull(finish_time, sysdate()) else finish_time end, update_time = sysdate() where course_id = #{courseId} and student_id = #{studentId} and enroll_status = '1'
